reviewItem.question: Does "Cilium CLI: Upgrade Cilium CLI to v0.15.0 or later to switch to Helm installation mode to install and manage Cilium v1.16" mean a change to product-relationship:cilium|name=cilium-cli (requirement-changed)?

proposed.statement: Cilium CLI must be upgraded to v0.15.0 or later and switched to Helm installation mode to install and manage Cilium v1.16; classic installation mode is no longer supported, and migrating from classic to Helm mode requires uninstalling with classic mode CLI and reinstalling with Helm mode CLI.
